question: How many Vande Bharat trains were flagged off by Prime Minister Narendra Modi via video conferencing on September 24, 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian railways floated a tender for 58 Vande Bharat train sets after Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced in his Independence Day speech that 75 such trains will be launched in 75 weeks of Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav to connect different parts of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Vande Bharat Express, also known as Train 18 is a semi-high-speed train under the Make in India initiative.
 
• It was designed and manufactured by Integral Coach Factory (ICF) at Perambur, Chennai.
 
• The train is capable of running at a maximum speed of 200 km/h.
 
• Currently, two Vande Bharat trains are in operation: Delhi to Katra and Delhi to Varanasi.
 
• As per the tender, New coaches will be manufactured at the Integral Coach Factory (ICF) in Chennai, Modern Coach Factory (MCF) in Rae Bareilly, and Rail Coach Factory (RCF) in Kapurthala.
 
• ICF will manufacture 30 rakes, while MCF & RCF will manufacture 14 rakes each.
